contract.scene: 1000 actually visible objects, 200 full text labels, grouped painter order, other optimization switches off
contract.sampling: 30 samples after 15 warmup per unprofiled and profiled phase, serial quiet software WebGL cohort; short restored-method control afterward
contract.timing: Synchronous CPU wall-time scopes, not GPU timestamps or pure JS CPU cost. Exclusive subtracts nested measured scopes. Frame residual includes unwrapped framework work. Scope quantiles cannot be summed.
contract.limits: Controls always precede profiled samples. Warm state, observer overhead, allocations, GC and scheduling can change timings; control/profiled differences do not estimate optimization speedup or calibrated observer overhead.
